status: Exploratory local test; no deployment or routing change

method.production_path: 11 cases per mode, 8 inference calls and 3 abstentions; same plugin preparation, Studio, provider and parser; explicit think boolean; no seed pinned
method.actual_reasoning: 5 paired cases, one sample per mode, alternating order; explicit raw SmolLM3 assistant prefix; no schema in either mode; seed 42; temperature 0.3; num_ctx 4096; token ceilings 900 off and 1500 on
method.scope: Synthetic development cases. Fresh input, voice and form unchanged. Raw framing is a diagnostic backend, not the production transport. No Laya, Editor, Granite or end-to-end throughput measurement.
method.assessment: Manual review of final answer against exact input reports, including qualifications, attribution and source boundaries. Reasoning contents are excluded from artifacts; presence and character counts are retained. No automated semantic judge or new threshold.

limits: The initial think-flag comparison did not verify reasoning activation on any completed call; its timings cannot measure reasoning overhead.
Raw-prefix comparison changes transport and decoding relative to production, so it is diagnostic rather than a release test.
Single sample per case and mode; no significance or general model-ranking claim.
Incomplete provider calls retain elapsed time and error but not raw output or reasoning counts in the replay wrapper.
